title: Employ staff under the Commercial Sales Award 2020
what: Pay and employ staff at no less than the terms of the Commercial Sales Award 2020.

sources.title: Commercial Sales Award 2020
sources.quote: 4.1 This occupational award covers employers throughout Australia with respect to Commercial Travellers, Merchandisers and Advertising Sales Representatives and those employees unless any other modern award contains classifications that apply to such persons, in which case the other modern award prevails.

reach.condition: if it employs commercial travellers, merchandisers or advertising sales representatives and no other award with those classifications applies (cl 4.1)
reach.note: National system employers that are companies, in every state.

sources.title: Which system of employment laws applies
sources.publisher: Government of Western Australia (Private Sector Labour Relations)
sources.quote: The state system covers: Private sector businesses and their employees that operate as: Sole traders. Partnerships, where none of the partners in the business is a constitutional corporation (trading or financial corporation).

confidence_note: Occupational award; any other award with classifications for these staff prevails (cl 4.1).

assessment.summary: The Commercial Sales Award sets classifications, minimum pay and allowances for commercial travellers, merchandisers and advertising sales representatives where no other award covers them.

marks.reason: Classifications, allowances, penalty rates and their record-keeping add to the cost and complexity of employing in the industry.
